messages:
alex: Heads-up — Prometheus rollup for GPU saturation in us-west-2 is showing weird short spikes per-tenant. Thinking we need a heatmap-style view to pair saturation (gpu_utilization) with allocation queue latency so we can see who's burning error budget quickly.

alex: Query I'm looking at:
```promql
sum by (tenant) (avg_over_time(gpu_utilization{region="us-west-2"}[5m]))
```

maria: +1 on heatmap. current per-tenant line charts are noisy. If we do a 2D heatmap (saturation vs queue latency) we can visualize "hot tenants" even if absolute load is low. :heatmap:

jia: Also consider normalizing by reserved GPUs per-tenant. tenant A has 10 reserved GPUs -> 90% is different than tenant B with 1. Maybe compute a 'saturation_ratio = util / reserved_count'.

leonard: For EB impact we should overlay error-budget burn rate (tokens/sec cost of retries) — quick question: can Grafana show a composite panel with Prometheus heatmap + small sparkline for EB burn on hover? 

alex: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ABCD/gpu-ops (mock). I think a dashboard with per-tenant cell, top-right mini-sparkline for EB burn, bottom-left numeric for current queue-p99.

oncall-bot: ALERT: gpu_saturation_spike(us-west-2) fired for cluster=gpu-pool-7, triggered_at=2100001240

maria: saw the alert. I pulled logs — a tail of allocation errors: 
```text
Allocator failed: insufficient_free_gpus for tenant="studio-x"
``` 
This lines up with a tenant suddenly ramping training jobs.

jia: Possible quick mitigations: 1) soft-evict preemptible workloads 2) route new allocation to other regions 3) throttle tenant allocation tokens. Which runway do we prefer?

leonard: Ops preference = soft-evict preemptibles first. But need automated policy. If we tie it to SLI threshold (e.g., sat_ratio > 0.95 for 3m) then trigger evict.

alex: Agree. For dashboarding work I'll prototype a PromQL that emits sat_ratio and queue_p99 per tenant, and a second series for eb_burn_rate:
```promql
sat_ratio = gpu_utilization / tenant_reserved_gpus
queue_p99 = histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(allocation_queue_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, tenant))
eb_burn = increase(error_budget_consumed_tokens_total[1m])
```

maria: Ping me when prototype is up — I can wire the panel and an annotation for oncall-bot alerts. Also want a per-region filter.

jia: Also capture 'burst' buckets — short lived spikes can blow the burn without sustained inc. We should flag transient vs sustained.

alex: I'll spin up a branch and post a link. If anyone wants to mock panel behavior, drop a tenant name and I'll inject test metrics. :+1:

leonard: tenant list for test: studio-x, analytics-svc, api-batch, rl-research

maria: noted. thanks. I'll follow up with a grafana panel PR once alex posts the branch.

oncall-bot: NOTE: incident ticket #INC-5721 created for the spike (assigned: eng-sre)
